Photo Courtesy of the Author

Dear Reader,

Welcome to my little corner of the world!

I don’t often lay on about myself, but here goes. I am Liz and I have been a writer for over 20 years now. The stories I write tend to be about people that are living a different life than I am or that have been through something that changed their lives. Sometimes I write about myself, but only when I think there is value in sharing some part of me.

What do I mean by that? Well, I think everyone has had a problem, a challenge, a mistake, a loss, a change that we can learn from. If I have learned something that I think will help someone else, then I’ll share it and give them a chance to learn as well.

This blog isn’t for everybody. There will be people reading who won’t like it. It’s okay if they don’t. But if you have an open mind and you think you might like some stories with an interesting take away at the end, then keep reading!

My first featured story was a story that a friend shared with me. I wrote it up and put a title and a photo on it. It wasn’t long, just a few paragraphs long. I wanted to give people a chance to learn from it.

The title was, “A Lesson From My Mother.” The lesson was, “Don’t try to change other people.”

My mother always said that. She didn’t say it quite like that, but the meaning was the same. I remember her saying it all the time. When I was a little girl, she would tell me when she saw me trying to get someone else to do something she way that I was trying to change the other person, which she didn’t want me to do. As an adult, I see how right she was.

Photo by Harry Knight on Unsplash

“Card games, now that’s a good way to pass the time.”

An older woman observes my group of fifteen high school students huddled in circles playing games. We’ve just spent a week in the mountains. The sun is out, the weather is perfect, and there isn’t a cell tower or any form of internet within 50 miles. I can see by her look that she disapproves of what we’re doing.

And she is right. We shouldn’t be playing card games.

Let me explain why. We should be using this time for something better. Something which would be more productive. Something which could help us get ahead in life. We are young. We have a lot of time. There isn’t anything wrong with enjoying ourselves. But we need to balance it. We should not waste our lives.

The truth is that this is not the only time when I will notice something is wrong. I’ll remember this moment whenever my phone buzzes. Or I am watching some video or movie. Or if I open my web browser.

It’s all so familiar. I am a 17-year-old student. We live in an age where the internet is always at your fingertips. You can find almost anything you want on the web. The internet has changed a lot since I was your age. I know there are many people who love the internet. And I understand the internet can be fun. But it’s too easy to become obsessed with the internet. It’s too easy to spend so much of your time online instead of focusing on school and getting ahead.

I do like the internet. The internet is great. But there is one problem. Too many people are spending too much time online. And that’s a problem. And I am one of them.
